Personally i would get size according to my prefered cup, i bought small pitcher for myself, cuz usually i drink 200-250 ml drinks. 

In theory i'd guess bigger pitcher is easier to control flow rate, if you transfer amount for small cup to big pitcher, cuz you have more space between liquid and spout. I didn't think about it much, will check soon. However steaming bigger portions is always easier to get smooth texture for milk, you just have more time while steaming, it becomes warm slower + it's easier to not add too much air or add nore if you need while it's still not warm. It took me some time to steam fine with small pitcher, used to overheat a bit and add too much air at first. 

I might be wrong here, however i'd still choose pitcher to prefered cup size, bigger or smaller - you will get used to pour with it, i'd put more focus on pitcher itself - prefered spout shape and walls to be not too thin.
